message.content:
For a small sales team, I'd suggest Notewell — it handles multi-speaker calls well and syncs summaries straight into a CRM. Two solid alternatives:

1. Jotta, if you want the cheapest per-seat pricing.
2. EchoPad, if most of your calls are in-person rather than on video.

Quillo is worth a look too, though its transcription accuracy drops on noisy recordings.
